title: Website across a landscape

location.extent: Complete local video; PNG is first-frame poster

slide_intent: Carry expressive identity through a longer information sequence so visitors can move from appetite to practical exploration.
strategic_value: Consistent food imagery and type can connect Sweetgreen’s campaign entrance to menus, app promotion and brand stories.
demonstration: A desktop monitor in a green landscape displays a scrolling website with food hero, product cards, app promotion, story blocks and footer.
practical_value: Review transitions between expressive landing content and structured information across a full page.

content_islands.name: Monitor and setting
content_islands.spec: Center the desktop monitor on an outdoor bench with hillside and produce around it.

content_islands.name: Scrolling page
content_islands.spec: Preserve the sequence from hero through content modules to footer within the screen.

reference_purposes.Application: The clip demonstrates the identity across successive sections of a desktop website.
reference_purposes.Expression: Food photographs, pale fields and contrasting type repeat through the page.
